Definition: from the same as G1077; legitimate (of birth), i.e. genuine:--own, sincerity, true.
BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, gnḗsios is the word for own, sincerity, true. In 2 Corinthians 8:8, the text says "and to prove the sincerity of your love." In Philippians 4:3, the text says "true yokefellow."
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that gnḗsios matters because truth is not whatever we feel; it is what God has said, and it stands. That is why I keep this word in mind when I read those passages — it carries more than its size suggests.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
